title: His father's beginnings on violin and Harris's own lessons
summary: Harris thinks his father started on violin, and says he took two lessons a week after school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Had he ever played anything else except the reed instruments? Do you know what he started on or anything about his early life? Had he ever talked to you about music much?

Well I think my daddy started on the violin. Wow. Yeah, because I had a violin at the house, I tried to fool it too. I didn't fool the clarinet but I had the violin. And that's how I started. I just kept a fool out of the instrument until I just picked it up and went on to listen.
How many lessons you took a week? One or two? Two.
I used to take two lessons everywhere when I come from school.
